about_the_game:
As a child, you witnessed the fall of your noble house and that left you with many burning questions about the tragedy that transpired. Seeking answers, you come to the royal palace, where you will be the governess to the young princess of the empire.

Soon, you realize that under the glittering chandeliers and behind excessive decadence, the palace is not as perfect as it seems. 

When the young princess suddenly becomes ill, you have no choice but to seek one of the princes for help:

Maximilian: He’s a man of a few words and a stern demeanor. But why do you glimpse at something softer behind his icy exterior?

Lucian: He’s warm and welcoming. But why do you feel that you are looking at a mask?

As you draw closer and closer to the revelation. You realize that maybe, just maybe, some truths might be best forgotten.

Will you be able to survive the consequences that follow? Or will it consume you and the ones you love?

👑 Two Unique Routes: Each prince is fighting their demons, waiting for someone to see them for who they truly are.

💔 8+ Endings: Multiple endings range from heartbreaking betrayals to happily ever afters.

⚔️ Strong Heroine: Play the brave and intelligent heroine, who refuses to be a pawn in anyone’s game.

🔥 Slow-Burn Romance & Forbidden Love: Prepare for shimmering tension intermingled with heart-fluttering moments.

🎭 Expressive, Animated Characters: All the characters are animated and express a wide range of emotions.

🎨 Hand-Drawn and Animated CGs: Key moments are illuminated with beautiful artworks that truly bring the story to life.

content_descriptors.notes: Fate's Masquerade contains mature themes, and player discretion is advised. These include but are not limited to violence, blood, murder, human death, animal death, strong language, alcohol references, and sexual references.

  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0

short_description: Looking for steamy romances with brooding and enigmatic princes? Step into Fate’s Masquerade, where danger meets desire. Unravel secrets, navigate court politics, and make choices that shape your destiny. Along the way, surrender to love so powerful it will change the fate of an empire.
